answer: Correlation penalties: treat each agent as a vertex in an activity graph and flag clusters that act in lockstep, sharing timing, wording, or funding sources. Rewards for a flagged cluster are split as if it were one agent, so a raven-like flock of fake identities earns no more than a single bird. The attacker must pay to make every sybil behave independently, which pushes them toward the ledge where faking diversity costs more than the rewards it captures.
